intro: I'm Darsh, a student at Shamrock International School in Vijayawada. I got into computer science the way people get into puzzles: one problem, then another, until it became a habit.

Over time the puzzles got bigger. I didn't only want to know how AI works. I wanted to know whether it could work for people who would never call themselves technical. That question became Kisan AI. A curiosity about what models remember became a research paper on machine unlearning.
Away from code you'll find me on a basketball court, in a committee room arguing about AI policy, or volunteering. I've learned that the hardest problems are rarely only technical.
